dev_hana: Heads up — I ran a batch of mixed-precision benchmarks (FP8 inference with INT8 matmul fallbacks) on eu-west A100s and saw ~20% tail latency spikes after ~2k tokens. Logs attached below. Can we triage whether this is a calibration artifact, KV cache thrash, or kernel selector flip?

rik: :eyes: do you have the exact config? batcher settings, kernel hints, and power cap?

dev_hana: Config pasted from run: ```
MODEL=redwood-mix-small
PRECISION=fp8+int8
BATCHER=continuous
BATCH_SIZE=8
WARMUP_ITERS=50
MAX_SEQ=1024
POWER_LIMIT=250W
KV_CACHE=true
KERNEL_POLICY=auto
CALIBRATION=dynamic
```

morgan: That WARMUP_ITERS looks low for FP8 heuristics. FP8 kernels often need longer microbench warmups for stable kernel selection. Try 200-500 and see if selection stabilizes.

zach: Also check tokenization pattern — lots of small prompts then long generations will change seq distribution and affect kernel choice. Did you pin random seeds for sampling?

dev_hana: Seeds pinned. Tokenization is mixed: 70% short (<32) prompts, 30% long (>512). The regressions align with transitions from short->long in the same worker.

perf-ci-bot: CI Run 2026-03-05T14:12:30Z finished. Benchmark id: run-20260305-42. Median throughput: 320 tok/s, 95p latency 180ms, observed spikes to 410ms on step 2048. Full trace: https://ci.internal/runs/run-20260305-42

rik: If kernel selector flips based on rolling histograms, a burst of long sequences could change the chosen kernel mid-stream. That could trigger kernel reloads and cause spikes. We should log kernel selection events in the runtime for a short window.

santiago: Agreed. Also KV cache eviction patterns matter: if we occasionally purge KV blocks due to memory heuristic and then rebuild, you get a short CPU/GPU spike while recomputing caches. Do you see cache miss counters rising?

dev_hana: Cache miss counter jumps correlate with latency spikes. I captured a small perf trace (abridged): ```
[2026-03-05 14:13:20] step=2038 kernel=matmul_fp8_fast size=4096 selected=true
[2026-03-05 14:13:21] step=2048 kernel=safe_int8 size=8192 selected=true // selector flip
[2026-03-05 14:13:21] kv_cache: evict_pages=12 rebuild_ms=34
[2026-03-05 14:13:21] latency_ms=412
```

morgan: That `rebuild_ms=34` is suspiciously high — should be single-digit ms for our page size. Might be a locking contention with the batcher thread. Can you run with `--kv-debug-locks`?

zach: For fair quantization comparisons we also need to standardize power capping and thermal state: please run golden runs with power limit strict and GPU warmed to steady temp. Power fluctuation can change throughput of int8 kernels.

dev_hana: Will re-run with: `WARMUP_ITERS=300 POWER_LIMIT=300W --kv-debug-locks --log-kernel-selection` and include a sampling-only run (no sampling randomness) for perf baseline.

rik: Also include an isolated single-model run (no multi-tenant traffic) to rule out cross-tenant scheduling. If the selector relies on perf counters that differ under load, results will vary.

santiago: One more thought — calibration mode dynamic means quant params may be recomputed online. If calibration recalibrates on long sequence patterns it could change quant scales and force different kernels. Try `CALIBRATION=offline` with precomputed scales.

dev_hana: Good call. I'll run four conditions: online vs offline calibration, warmup 50 vs 300, continuous batcher vs fixed batcher, and power 250W vs 300W. Sharing matrix and ETA ~ today EOD.

morgan: If you can, attach a tiny reproducer that toggles only `CALIBRATION` to demonstrate delta — that'll make it easier to file a regression.

dev_hana: Will do. For transparency I'm saving raw perf counters, kernel logs, and kv debug to s3: s3://redwood-test/perf/1912345678-artifacts/ — I'll post links when done.

perf-ci-bot: New artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-test/perf/1912345678-artifacts/summary.json

zach: Thanks — once we have the matrix results we should run a small statistical test (paired runs) to claim a real perf difference and not noise. 10 repeats each recommended.

santiago: And document the tokenization mix used. For reproducibility include a seed list for prompt sampler and the exact tokenizer binary+version.

dev_hana: Noted. Plan is 10 repeats, pinned seeds, tokenization dump, and a short write-up on what changed between conditions. I'll drop results in this thread. :thumbsup:
